description: Validator for the callcenter_agent callflow data object

action.description: Which change to make to the calling user's availability. toggle_login on the pattern ^\*22([0-9]*)$ toggles the agent whose presence_id is the captured extension instead: the caller's own, or anybody's when the caller is an account admin

presence_id.description: Presence id of the BLF key that shows this agent's login; remembered for later changes. Empty uses <prefix><presence_id>

require_pin.description: Ask for an agent id and a PIN even when the call carries an owner, so that the agent who types them is the one whose availability changes rather than the phone's owner

skip_module.description: When set to true this callflow action is skipped, advancing to the wildcard branch (if any)

timeout.description: Seconds the agent stays on break before returning to their previous availability, 0 for no limit
